status: outcome-informed method-development design frozen after the Caltech entity-level and local-gate results were observed
claim_guard: This audit was motivated by observed Caltech outcomes and by the failure of multiplicative local OOD gates. It may establish a transparent method-development mechanism and conditional robustness on this target, but it cannot serve as independent confirmation or prospective discovery.
scientific_question: Can qualified neighboring rankings discover more distinct high-value target regions when credibility is decided at source level, complementary ranks are preserved, and the acquisition unit is diversified across provenance-linked formulation groups?

strategy.credibility: Admit the predeclared OBELiX same-property and ESTM transport-neighbor rankings; retain Borg mechanical and OCx catalysis as wrong-domain controls. Source credibility is not inferred from source-only OOF R2.
strategy.complementarity: Fuse the two admitted source ranks by unweighted Borda rank sum. Keep source-specific results and round-robin allocation visible so that one source cannot be credited for another source's proposals.
strategy.abstention: A wrong, shuffled, or unqualified source receives no allocation in the final protocol; this audit evaluates those counterfactual portfolios rather than silently removing them.
strategy.family_first: Traverse an outcome-free candidate order once while selecting only the first candidate from each connected provenance/formulation group; append remaining within-group candidates only after every represented group has had one opportunity.
strategy.ood_role: OOD distance is a reporting and constrained-budget variable, not a multiplicative reward. It cannot override a qualified source rank.
strategy.fallback: Composition novelty and uniform family-first orders are target-only safety comparators.

primary_endpoint.top_region: top ceil(5 percent) groups ranked by their best observed target value
primary_endpoint.metric: AUC of cumulative first recovery of distinct top groups through acquisition 20
primary_endpoint.secondary: distinct top-group recall at 20 and first-recovery positions

sensitivity_endpoints: top groups defined by median target value
top groups defined by mean target value
original entity-level AUC20 and recall20 to expose the breadth-versus-repeat tradeoff

conditional_null.procedure: independently permute the OBELiX and ESTM candidate predictions within each fixed candidate scope, rebuild the family-first consensus order, and compare AUC20
conditional_null.interpretation: conditional candidate-pool randomization, not external-target uncertainty

future_freeze: The CCA family-first rule, source admission criteria, group construction, endpoints, and source-specific hypothesis cards must be frozen before outcomes on the next target are revealed.
